channel.description: Latest articles from Long Island Business News (libn.com)

item.title: NFocus Management Group LLC
item.description: Rose Ward is an influential leader, strategist, and capacity-building professional dedicated to strengthening the small business ecosystem across New York State.

item.title: Spero Lighting East Inc.
item.description: Spero Lighting East is helping Long Island businesses see lighting not just as an operational necessity, but as a strategic investment in efficiency, safety and sustainability.

item.title: Creative Focus Designs Inc.
item.description: Based in Malverne, Creative Focus Designs is a premier full-service visual communications firm specializing in high-end photography, videography, and graph c design.

item.title: YHP Cares
item.description: YHP Cares is a Long Island–based, minority-owned service coordination agency dedicated to making New York State’s Medicaid system work better for the people who rely on it most.

item.title: Kimco Realty grows revenue and net income
item.description: Kimco Realty increased net income to $554.4 million and funds from operations to $1.2 billion in 2025, driven by strong leasing and occupancy rates.

item.title: US Supreme Court invalidates Trump’s tariffs under IEEPA in 6-3 ruling
item.description: The US Supreme Court ruled 6-3 that Trump's use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act to impose global tariffs exceeded presidential authority.

item.title: LI Pizza Strong to raise funds for fallen officer’s family
item.description: LI Pizza Strong’s Feb. 25 event unites hundreds of pizzerias to raise funds for the family of fallen Nassau Police Officer Patricia Espinosa.

item.title: Planning for Success in 2026
item.description: 2025 was a good year for many businesses on Long Island helped by lower interest rates, improved sales and easier hiring with more people looking for work than available jobs.

item.title: Educators, veterans honor Black History Month on Long Island
item.description: Educators and veterans on Long Island gathered to honor African American contributions to military service during Black History Month at the Museum of American Armor in Old Bethpage.

item.title: Just Salad opens another LI location with more to come
item.description: Just Salad opens its ninth Long Island location in Massapequa Park and plans two more openings here later this year.
